label: Raze
fundamentals: Boom Bot and Paint Shells clear the close positions that stop your entry. Send the clear first, then move while the defender is displaced.
Blast Pack creates fast space, but the landing still needs cover or teammate pressure. Use the second pack to finish the route or escape the trade.
Showstopper is strongest after utility or contact narrows the defender's exits. Fire at the space they must cross instead of guessing at a hidden player.

patchHistory.note: Boom Bot can now be concussed.
Slows now reduce Blast Pack movement while Raze is airborne.

abilities.name: Blast Pack
abilities.summary: INSTANTLY throw a Blast Pack that will stick to surfaces. RE-USE the ability after deployment to detonate, moving anything hit and dealing damage if fully armed.

stats.Source: Riot game text + Valorant Wiki current infobox

abilities.purpose: Create fast entry space, reposition through vertical routes, break utility, or escape the trade after first contact.
abilities.setup: Pick a landing before you satchel. The movement is powerful only when the destination has cover or teammate pressure attached.

abilities.name: Paint Shells
abilities.summary: EQUIP a cluster grenade. FIRE to throw the grenade, which does damage and creates sub-munitions, each doing damage to anyone in their range. ALT FIRE to lob. Paint Shells charge resets every two kills.

stats.Source: Riot game text + Valorant Wiki current infobox

abilities.purpose: Clear tight angles, deny a choke, punish trapped players, and force defenders out before the entry swing.
abilities.setup: Throw it where defenders still need to stand, not where they already escaped. Paint Shells is best when a teammate can punish the exit path.

abilities.name: Boom Bot
abilities.summary: EQUIP a Boom Bot. FIRE will deploy the bot, causing it to travel in a straight line on the ground, bouncing off walls. The Boom Bot will lock on to any enemies in its frontal cone and chase them, exploding for heavy damage if it reaches them.

stats.Source: Riot game text + Valorant Wiki current infobox

abilities.purpose: Clear close corners, force a defender to shoot, and create a safe entry timing through the noise and displacement.
abilities.setup: Send it into the first danger pocket your entry cannot safely face-check. Swing while the defender is dodging or breaking the bot.

abilities.name: Showstopper
abilities.summary: EQUIP a rocket launcher. FIRE to shoot a rocket that does massive area damage on contact with anything.

stats.Source: Riot game text + Valorant Wiki current infobox

abilities.purpose: Break a stacked defense, punish a trapped opponent, or force a retake player away from the spike timer.
abilities.setup: Narrow the enemy's exits first with utility, contact, or teammate pressure. Fire at the space they must cross rather than at a guessed hiding spot.

lore.label: Origin
lore.note: Raze brings a bold personality and a large collection of explosives from Brazil into every operation.

lore.label: Lore
lore.note: Her aggressive tools excel at clearing tight positions and dislodging opponents who rely on entrenched cover.
